description:
What if finding your ideal calorie target was just one message away? Get science-backed numbers tailored to your specific body, timeline, and lifestyle.

Just tell me your goals or ask, "How many calories do I need to lose weight?" to generate your personalized nutrition plan.

Turn that advice into action. Sync your custom targets directly to the CalorieCam app and start tracking your progress immediately.

defaultPrompt: How many calories should I eat to lose weight?
How many calories and macros should I eat to maintain my weight?
How much sodium should I consume per day?
